title: Sessions
noResultsHint: Try checking the query explainer in the search bar if there are any search syntax issues.
addDataSourceHint: Add new data sources by setting up a {{brand}} integration.
setupDescription: Follow these steps to start recording and viewing session replays with the {{brand}} Otel Collector.
step1Label: Create a new source with Session type
step1Description: Go to Team Settings, click Add Source under Sources section, and select Session as the source type.
step2Description: Select the hyperdx_sessions table from the dropdown, and select the corresponding trace source.
step3Description: Install the <link>{{brand}} Browser Integration</link> to start recording sessions.
updateSourceHint: Go to Team Settings and update the {{sourceName}} source to include the correlated session source.
